result.title: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
result.summary: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何在无动作视频学得的 latent action 空间中用离线 RL 做策略改进：指出直接在 latent 上最大化价值或拟合单峰策略会产生物理不可执行的动作，且 latent 可能合并奖励不同的控制，据此推导策略改进可迁移到解码执行的条件，并提出基于条件 flow policy 的 LAPIS。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对 latent 表示合并异质控制、latent 最优与解码后最优何时对齐的分析，可能为 LVR 中「latent 状态优化能否对应有效推理步骤」及 latent 多峰分布、信息坍缩问题提供可供核查的线索，但论文属机器人控制场景，联系需较多迁移判断。
